title: Blocktown
description: Build your own city in 3D. Draw curved roads, roundabouts and tunnels, paint zones and watch houses, shops and towers grow. Add landmarks that bring visitors, run buses, trams and a metro, and keep traffic flowing, the power on and your citizens happy, through day and night, rain, snow and the odd flood. Play it chill with endless money, or grow from a camp to a megacity and climb the high-score lists.
description_de: Bau deine eigene Stadt in 3D. Zeichne geschwungene Strassen, Kreisel und Tunnel, male Zonen und sieh zu, wie Häuser, Läden und Türme wachsen. Bau Wahrzeichen, die Besucher anlocken, betreibe Busse, Trams und eine Metro, und halte den Verkehr im Fluss, den Strom am Laufen und deine Einwohner glücklich, bei Tag und Nacht, Regen, Schnee und ab und zu einem Hochwasser. Spiel ganz entspannt mit endlos Geld oder wachse vom Lager zur Megastadt und klettere in den Bestenlisten.
controls: Tap the green build button to build. Mouse: left drag moves, right drag turns, wheel zooms. Touch: one finger moves or builds, two fingers move, zoom and turn; drag the round handles to adjust a road. Keys: W A S D, Q E, Space to pause, Enter to build.
update_title: Blocktown 2: a new look, landmarks and smarter traffic
notes: A brand-new interface: a big build button, cards with every building in 3D, and celebrations when your city grows
Much easier building with a finger: drag handles to move and bend roads, then tap the tick
Ten landmarks, from City Hall to a Space Centre, that bring visitors and money
New roads: one-way streets, roundabouts, tunnels, tram avenues with trams, and traffic lights
Smoother on phones, a battery saver, and traffic that no longer drives through itself
